Yes — and you already have most of the stack. The [STE kit](https://github.com/woosal1337/blog/tree/main/videos/ep01-the-cure-for-ai-slop) is worth borrowing from, but **not** as a full import.

## What you already have (and it's the right shape)

Your setup matches the episode's main finding: **a writing system beats a banned-words list**.

| Layer | You | STE kit |
|-------|-----|---------|
| Agent skill | `jorap-voice`, `garden-voice` (7 passes, swap test, likability) | `ste-writing-skill.md` |
| Vocabulary lint | `data/voice-words.yaml` + `pnpm lint:voice` | `ste-lint.py` banned/marketing words |
| Structural lint | `data/slop-rules.yaml` + `pnpm lint:slop` | sentence length, passive voice, nominalizations |
| Cursor rule | `.cursor/rules/anti-slop.mdc` | — |

The episode's headline numbers line up with that: banned-words alone barely moved the needle; a **system** (Orwell or STE) cut slop ~50–74%. Your skills + lints are already that system — tuned for JoRap, not generic tech docs.

## What STE adds that you don't (yet)

`ste-lint.py` checks **mechanical form** your linters mostly skip:

- **Nominalizations** — "perform an analysis of" instead of "analyze"
- **Passive voice** — "the file is read by the parser"
- **`-ing` main verbs** — "is ensuring that…"
- **Phrasal verbs** — "spin up", "dive into", "circle back"
- **Sentence length** — flags sentences over 20 words
- **Score delta workflow** — lint draft → apply skill → lint again; the drop is the signal

Those are the high-value steals. A banned-word expansion alone is the weakest lever (their Claude run: -3% for word lists vs -74% for STE).

## What not to copy (conflicts with your voice)

STE is built for **aircraft manuals** — voice stripped on purpose. Several rules fight JoRap:

| STE rule | Your voice |
|----------|------------|
| No contractions | Blog body wants `it's`, `don't`, `I've` |
| Max 20–25 words/sentence | You want one-word punches *and* longer explanatory sentences |
| Impersonal, third-person | Blog is first-person; notes `description` is third-person but `examples`/`gloss` use "I" |
| "Write only the text, no preamble" | Personal posts need hooks, scenes, dry asides |

So: borrow **STE-flavored** mechanics, not **strict STE**. The kit itself calls this out — `STE-flavored` mode relaxes the dictionary lockdown for general prose.

## Practical additions (ranked)

**1. Port selective `ste-lint` checks into `slop-lint` or a new `pnpm slop:score`**

Add as **warn**, not CI fail — personal voice needs long sentences sometimes:

- Nominalization patterns (`tion/ment/ance of`, "perform a…", "make use of")
- Passive voice when actor is obvious
- Phrasal verbs (`dive into`, `leverage` as verb — you already flag the word)
- Optional: sentence-length histogram (warn if >30% of sentences exceed 25 words)

**2. Expand `data/voice-words.yaml` with STE swaps you don't have**

Low-risk adds from their list:

- `ensure` → make sure / check
- `commence` / `initiate` → start
- `prior to` → before
- `subsequent to` → after
- `demonstrate` → show
- `in order to` → to

Keep your `review:` tier for words that are OK in dev context (`leverage`, `robust`).

**3. Add a "lint delta" step to the skills**

One line in `jorap-voice` and `garden-voice` workflow:

```bash
pnpm slop:score draft.md   # before passes
# … seven passes …
pnpm slop:score draft.md   # after — score should drop
```

That encodes the episode's core workflow without new rules prose.

**4. Tighten `anti-slop.mdc` with 3 STE-flavored bullets**

Worth adding to the rule (agents read rules on every edit in those globs):

- **One verb, not a noun pile** — "analyze the log", not "perform an analysis of the log"
- **Name the actor** — passive only when the actor truly doesn't matter
- **Short word wins** — start/use/help/before/after/show over commence/utilize/facilitate/prior to

**5. Skip**

- Full `ste-writing-skill.md` as a separate skill (duplicates jorap-voice)
- Strict 20-word sentence cap in CI (will false-positive on good JoRap paragraphs)
- STE's no-contractions rule

## Bottom line

Rules and lints **do** reduce slop — you already prove that with `anti-slop.mdc`, voice skills, and two lint gates. The STE kit's lesson isn't "add more banned words"; it's **add machine-checkable form rules** (nominalizations, passive voice, phrasal filler) and **measure before/after**.

The highest-ROI next step: port the mechanical checks from `ste-lint.py` into your existing `slop-lint.py` as warnings, plus a score command for the before/after delta. Keep jorap-voice/garden-voice as the voice layer — STE is the anti-slop skeleton; your skills are the personality on top.

<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
Creating slop-score.py with core logic. Integrating it into slop-lint and voice-lint. Updating files.

Slop-score.py adapts ste-lint for JoRap. It skips contraction penalties. It flags phrasal verbs. It flags nominalizations. It flags passive voice. It flags -ing main verbs. It flags long sentences. It warns when the long-sentence ratio exceeds 30%. The slop-lint integration adds a `mechanical_hits` function. It returns rule IDs and details. Nominalization triggers on any count. Passive voice triggers on two or more counts. Phrasal verbs trigger on any count. Long sentences trigger when the ratio exceeds thirty percent. An optional aggregate warning fires when the per-hundred-word score reaches three or higher.

slop-score.py will expose an `analyze()` function returning a dictionary. It defines regex patterns for phrasal verbs, auxiliary verbs, and past-participles. slop-rules.yaml will gain documented mechanical warning rules. slop-lint will get an `apply_mechanical_hits` function. voice-lint.py will support a `score` mode. package.json will add a `slop:score` script. Need to verify whether the score mode accepts file path arguments.

The slop-score CLI accepts files, stdin, and JSON output. It prints one line per file with word count, total violations, and per-hundred-word score. The score mode delegates to slop-score.main. slop-lint will integrate these warnings into scan_blog and scan_note. data/slop-rules.yaml will gain mechanical rules under blog.warn and notes.warn.

Mechanical rule kinds are defined as mechanical_nominalization, mechanical_passive, mechanical_phrasal, and mechanical_long_sentences. slop-score.py will be written as an importable module.
</details></think>

```bash
cd /home/jorap/Documents/GitHub/jorap.com && python3 - <<'PY'
import re, yaml
from pathlib import Path
BLOG = Path('content/english/blog')
FM = re.compile(r'^---\s*\n(.*?)\n---', re.DOTALL)
issues = []
for p in sorted(BLOG.glob('*.md')):
    if p.name.startswith('_'):
        continue
    text = p.read_text()
    m = FM.match(text)
    meta = yaml.safe_load(m.group(1)) if m else {}
    body = text[m.end():] if m else text
    draft = meta.get('draft', False)
    name = p.name
    flags = []
    if 'Expanded from' in body or 'Idea captured from' in body:
        flags.append('wiki-footer')
    if meta.get('image') == '/images/image-template.jpg':
        flags.append('placeholder-image')
    if len(re.findall(r'\b\w+\b', body)) < 80 and not draft:
        flags.append('body-too-short')
    if re.search(r'\b(users|one) (should|might|may)\b', body, re.I):
        flags.append('third-person-advice')
    if re.search(r"it is recommended|it'?s important to note", body, re.I):
        flags.append('passive-advice')
    if re.search(r'^## Bottom line\s*$', body, re.M) and set(meta.get('categories') or []) & {'Opinion','Faith','Family','Games','Sports'}:
        flags.append('bottom-line')
    if flags:
        issues.append((name, 'published' if not draft else 'draft', flags))
for name, status, flags in issues:
    print(f"{status:9} {name}: {', '.join(flags)}")
print(f"\nTotal flagged: {len(issues)}")
PY
```

```bash
print(f'\nDraft total: {len(draft)}, flagged: {sum(1 for x in draft if x[2])}')
```

```bash
import re, yaml
from pathlib import Path
FM = re.compile(r'^---\s*\n(.*?)\n---', re.DOTALL)
FIRST = re.compile(r'\b(I|my|I\'ve|I\'m)\b', re.I)
cats_need_i = {'Opinion','Faith','Family','Games','Sports'}
issues = []
for p in sorted(Path('content/english/blog').glob('*.md')):
    if p.name.startswith('_') or p.name == '_index.md': continue
    t = p.read_text(); m = FM.match(t)
    meta = yaml.safe_load(m.group(1)) if m else {}
    body = t[m.end():] if m else t
    pub = not meta.get('draft')
    cats = set(meta.get('categories') or [])
    if pub and cats & cats_need_i:
        opener = body[:400]
        if opener.strip() and not FIRST.search(opener):
            issues.append((p.name, 'no-I-opener', list(cats & cats_need_i)))
    # empty sections
    lines = body.splitlines()
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        if line.strip().startswith('## '):
            j = i+1
            while j < len(lines) and not lines[j].strip(): j += 1
            if j >= len(lines) or lines[j].strip().startswith('## ') or lines[j].strip() == '---':
                issues.append((p.name, 'empty-section', line.strip()[3:]))
for name, kind, detail in issues:
    print(f'{name}: {kind} {detail}')
print(f'total: {len(issues)}')
```

```bash
cd /home/jorap/Documents/GitHub/jorap.com && python3 - <<'PY'
import re, yaml
from pathlib import Path
FM = re.compile(r'^---\s*\n(.*?)\n---', re.DOTALL)
for p in sorted(Path('content/english/blog').glob('__*.md')):
    t = p.read_text(); m = FM.match(t)
    meta = yaml.safe_load(m.group(1)) if m else {}
    body = t[m.end():] if m else t
    flags = []
    if meta.get('image') == '/images/image-template.jpg': flags.append('placeholder-image')
    if len(re.findall(r'\b\w+\b', body)) < 80: flags.append(f'short-body({len(re.findall(r"\\b\\w+\\b", body))}w)')
    if re.search(r'\b(users|one) (should|might|may)\b', body, re.I): flags.append('third-person-advice')
    if re.search(r"it is recommended", body, re.I): flags.append('passive-advice')
    if 'Expanded from' in body or 'Idea captured from' in body: flags.append('wiki-footer')
    if flags:
        print(f"{p.name}: {', '.join(flags)}")
```

import re, yaml
from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util

spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(&#39;ss&#39;, Path(&#39;scripts/slop-score.py&#39;))
ss = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(spec)

FM = re.compile(r&#39;^---\s*\n(.*?)\n---&#39;, re.DOTALL)
FIRST = re.compile(r&#39;\b(I|my|I\&#39;ve|I\&#39;m)\b&#39;, re.I)
cats_need_i = {&#39;Opinion&#39;,&#39;Faith&#39;,&#39;Family&#39;,&#39;Games&#39;,&#39;Sports&#39;}

def audit(path):
    t = path.read_text(); m = FM.match(t)
    meta = yaml.safe_load(m.group(1)) if m else {}
    body = t[m.end():] if m else t
    draft = path.name.startswith(&#39;__&#39;) or meta.get(&#39;draft&#39;)
    r = ss.analyze_text(body)
    flags = ss.mechanical_flags(r)
    blockers = []
    if &#39;Expanded from&#39; in body or &#39;Idea captured from&#39; in body: blockers.append(&#39;wiki-footer&#39;)
    if meta.get(&#39;image&#39;) == &#39;/images/image-template.jpg&#39;: blockers.append(&#39;placeholder-image&#39;)
    if len(re.findall(r&#39;\b\w+\b&#39;, body)) &lt; 80 and not draft: blockers.append(&#39;short-body&#39;)
    if re.search(r&#39;\b(users|one) (should|might|may)\b&#39;, body, re.I): blockers.append(&#39;third-person&#39;)
    if re.search(r&#34;it is recommended&#34;, body, re.I): blockers.append(&#39;passive-advice&#39;)
    cats = set(meta.get(&#39;categories&#39;) or [])
    if not draft and cats &amp; cats_need_i and body[:400].strip() and not FIRST.search(body[:400]):
        blockers.append(&#39;no-I-opener&#39;)
    return {
        &#39;name&#39;: path.name,
        &#39;draft&#39;: draft,
        &#39;words&#39;: r[&#39;words&#39;],
        &#39;per100w&#39;: r[&#39;total_per100w&#39;],
        &#39;mech&#39;: [f[0] for f in flags],
        &#39;blockers&#39;: blockers,
        &#39;title&#39;: meta.get(&#39;title&#39;, &#39;?&#39;),
    }

rows = [audit(p) for p in sorted(Path(&#39;content/english/blog&#39;).glob(&#39;*.md&#39;)) if p.name != &#39;_index.md&#39;]
pub = [r for r in rows if not r[&#39;draft&#39;]]
drafts = [r for r in rows if r[&#39;draft&#39;]]

print(&#39;=== PUBLISHED (26) ===&#39;)
print(f&#34;CI blockers: {sum(1 for r in pub if r[&#39;blockers&#39;])}&#34;)
print(f&#34;Mechanical flags: {sum(1 for r in pub if r[&#39;mech&#39;])}&#34;)
print(f&#34;per100w &gt; 2.0: {sum(1 for r in pub if r[&#39;per100w&#39;] &gt; 2.0)}&#34;)
print(f&#34;per100w median: {sorted(r[&#39;per100w&#39;] for r in pub)[len(pub)//2]:.2f}&#34;)
print()
for r in sorted(pub, key=lambda x: -x[&#39;per100w&#39;]):
    note = []
    if r[&#39;blockers&#39;]: note.append(&#39;BLOCK:&#39; + &#39;,&#39;.join(r[&#39;blockers&#39;]))
    if r[&#39;mech&#39;]: note.append(&#39;mech:&#39; + &#39;,&#39;.join(r[&#39;mech&#39;]))
    if r[&#39;per100w&#39;] &gt; 2.0: note.append(&#39;HIGH-SCORE&#39;)
    flag = f&#34;  [{&#39;; &#39;.join(note)}]&#34; if note else &#39;&#39;
    print(f&#34;  {r[&#39;per100w&#39;]:5.2f}  {r[&#39;name&#39;]}{flag}&#34;)

print(&#39;\n=== DRAFTS (39) ===&#39;)

```bash
import re, yaml
from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util

spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('ss', Path('scripts/slop-score.py'))
ss = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(spec)

FM = re.compile(r'^---\s*\n(.*?)\n---', re.DOTALL)
FIRST = re.compile(r'\b(I|my|I\'ve|I\'m)\b', re.I)
cats_need_i = {'Opinion','Faith','Family','Games','Sports'}

def audit(path):
    t = path.read_text(); m = FM.match(t)
    meta = yaml.safe_load(m.group(1)) if m else {}
    body = t[m.end():] if m else t
    draft = path.name.startswith('__') or meta.get('draft')
    r = ss.analyze_text(body)
    flags = ss.mechanical_flags(r)
    blockers = []
    if 'Expanded from' in body or 'Idea captured from' in body: blockers.append('wiki-footer')
    if meta.get('image') == '/images/image-template.jpg': blockers.append('placeholder-image')
    if len(re.findall(r'\b\w+\b', body)) < 80 and not draft: blockers.append('short-body')
    if re.search(r'\b(users|one) (should|might|may)\b', body, re.I): blockers.append('third-person')
    if re.search(r"it is recommended", body, re.I): blockers.append('passive-advice')
    cats = set(meta.get('categories') or [])
    if not draft and cats & cats_need_i and body[:400].strip() and not FIRST.search(body[:400]):
        blockers.append('no-I-opener')
    return {
        'name': path.name,
        'draft': draft,
        'words': r['words'],
        'per100w': r['total_per100w'],
        'mech': [f[0] for f in flags],
        'blockers': blockers,
        'title': meta.get('title', '?'),
    }

rows = [audit(p) for p in sorted(Path('content/english/blog').glob('*.md')) if p.name != '_index.md']
pub = [r for r in rows if not r['draft']]
drafts = [r for r in rows if r['draft']]

print('=== PUBLISHED (26) ===')
print(f"CI blockers: {sum(1 for r in pub if r['blockers'])}")
print(f"Mechanical flags: {sum(1 for r in pub if r['mech'])}")
print(f"per100w > 2.0: {sum(1 for r in pub if r['per100w'] > 2.0)}")
print(f"per100w median: {sorted(r['per100w'] for r in pub)[len(pub)//2]:.2f}")
print()
for r in sorted(pub, key=lambda x: -x['per100w']):
    note = []
    if r['blockers']: note.append('BLOCK:' + ','.join(r['blockers']))
    if r['mech']: note.append('mech:' + ','.join(r['mech']))
    if r['per100w'] > 2.0: note.append('HIGH-SCORE')
    flag = f"  [{'; '.join(note)}]" if note else ''
    print(f"  {r['per100w']:5.2f}  {r['name']}{flag}")

print('\n=== DRAFTS (39) ===')
print(f"CI blockers if published today: {sum(1 for r in drafts if r['blockers'])}")

    flag = f"  [{'; '.join(note)}]" if note else ''
```

```bash
import re, yaml, importlib.util
from pathlib import Path
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('ss', Path('scripts/slop-score.py'))
ss = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(ss)
FM = re.compile(r'^---\s*\n(.*?)\n---', re.DOTALL)
FIRST = re.compile(r"\b(I|my|I've|I'm)\b", re.I)
NO_CONTRACTION = re.compile(r"\b(I am|It is|That is|do not|does not|did not|will not|is not|are not)\b")
cats_need_i = {'Opinion','Faith','Family','Games','Sports'}

def audit(path):
    t = path.read_text(); m = FM.match(t)
    meta = yaml.safe_load(m.group(1)) if m else {}
    body = t[m.end():] if m else t
    draft = path.name.startswith('__') or meta.get('draft')
    r = ss.analyze_text(body)
    flags = ss.mechanical_flags(r)
    blockers = []
    if 'Expanded from' in body or 'Idea captured from' in body: blockers.append('wiki-footer')
    if meta.get('image') == '/images/image-template.jpg': blockers.append('placeholder-image')
    if len(re.findall(r'\b\w+\b', body)) < 80 and not draft: blockers.append('short-body')
    if re.search(r'\b(users|one) (should|might|may)\b', body, re.I): blockers.append('third-person')
    if re.search(r"it is recommended", body, re.I): blockers.append('passive-advice')
    cats = set(meta.get('categories') or [])
    if not draft and cats & cats_need_i and body[:400].strip() and not FIRST.search(body[:400]):
        blockers.append('no-I-opener')
    stiff = len(NO_CONTRACTION.findall(body))
    return {'name': path.name, 'draft': draft, 'words': r['words'], 'per100w': r['total_per100w'],
```

```bash
import re, yaml, importlib.util
from pathlib import Path
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('ss', Path('scripts/slop-score.py'))
ss = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(ss)
FM = re.compile(r'^---\s*\n(.*?)\n---', re.DOTALL)
BE = r"(?:am|is|are|was|were|be|been|being)"
PP = "done|made|sent|read|built|kept|held|set|put|run|written|shown|given|taken|found|got|gotten|seen|known|thrown|drawn"
pat = re.compile(rf"\b({BE})\s+(\w+ed|{PP})\b", re.I)
for p in sorted(Path('content/english/blog').glob('*.md')):
    if p.name.startswith('_') or p.name == '_index.md': continue
    t = p.read_text(); m = FM.match(t)

    body = t[m.end():] if m else t
    hits = pat.findall(body)
    if len(hits) >= 2:
        print(f"\n=== {p.name} ({len(hits)} passives) ===")
        for sent in re.split(r'(?<=[.!?])\s+', body):
            if pat.search(sent):
                print(' ', sent.strip()[:120])
```

```bash
import re, yaml, importlib.util
from pathlib import Path
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('ss', Path('scripts/slop-score.py'))
ss = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(ss)
FM = re.compile(r'^---\s*\n(.*?)\n---', re.DOTALL)
NO_CONTRACTION = re.compile(r"\b(I am|It is|That is|do not|does not|did not|will not|is not|are not|I do not|I am not)\b")
pub_mech = pub_stiff = 0
for p in sorted(Path('content/english/blog').glob('*.md')):
    if p.name.startswith('_'): continue
    t = p.read_text(); m = FM.match(t)
    meta = yaml.safe_load(m.group(1)) if m else {}

    stiff = len(NO_CONTRACTION.findall(body))
    if flags: pub_mech += 1; print('mech:', p.name, [f[0] for f in flags])
    if stiff >= 8: pub_stiff += 1; print('stiff:', p.name, stiff)
print('published mechanical flags:', pub_mech, 'stiff>=8:', pub_stiff)
```

```bash
cd /home/jorap/Documents/GitHub/jorap.com && python3 - <<'PY'
import re, importlib.util
from pathlib import Path
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('ss', Path('scripts/slop-score.py'))
ss = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(ss)
FM = re.compile(r'^---\s*\n(.*?)\n---', re.DOTALL)
BE = r"(?:am|is|are|was|were|be|been|being)"
PP = "done|made|sent|read|built|kept|held|set|put|run|written|shown|given|taken|found|got|gotten|seen|known|thrown|drawn"
pat = re.compile(rf"\b({BE})\s+(\w+ed|{PP})\b", re.I)
files = [
'__interesting-facts-about-jorap.md','__jobs-to-be-done-framework.md','__mi-box-s.md',
'__password-managers.md','__why-brave-browser.md','__why-git-greatest-open-source-innovation.md','__worcestershire-sauce.md']
for name in files:
    p = Path('content/english/blog')/name
    body = p.read_text(); body = body[FM.match(body).end():]
    cleaned = ss.PASSIVE_SKIP.sub(' ', body)
    hits = pat.findall(cleaned)
    if len(hits) < 2: print(name, 'SKIP', len(hits)); continue
    print(f'\n=== {name} ({len(hits)}) ===')
    for sent in re.split(r'(?<=[.!?])\s+', body):
        sc = ss.PASSIVE_SKIP.sub(' ', sent)
        if len(pat.findall(sc)) >= 1:
            print(' ', sent.strip()[:140])
PY
```

```bash
import re, importlib.util
from pathlib import Path
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('ss', Path('slop-score.py'))
ss = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(ss)
FM = re.compile(r'^---\s*\n(.*?)\n---', re.DOTALL)
BE = r"(?:am|is|are|was|were|be|been|being)"
PP = "done|made|sent|read|built|kept|held|set|put|run|written|shown|given|taken|found|got|gotten|seen|known|thrown|drawn"
pat = re.compile(rf"\b({BE})\s+(\w+ed|{PP})\b", re.I)
root = Path('..')/'content/english/blog'
for name in sorted(root.glob('__*.md')):
    body = name.read_text(); body = body[FM.match(body).end():]
    cleaned = ss.PASSIVE_SKIP.sub(' ', body)
    hits = pat.findall(cleaned)
    if len(hits) >= 2:
        print(f'\n=== {name.name} ({len(hits)}) {hits} ===')
        for sent in re.split(r'(?<=[.!?])\s+', body):
            sc = ss.PASSIVE_SKIP.sub(' ', sent)
            m = pat.findall(sc)
            if m: print(' ', m, sent.strip()[:120])
```
